Receipt asymmetry: work verbs return nested record.id; conference-open/append-position return FLAT top-level recordId (writeExtensionState, cli/src/index.ts:551-559). Parsing record.id from a conference receipt yields undefined.

List flags split on ASCII comma only; '-' is the empty-list sentinel, not a literal; an ASCII comma inside a Chinese sentence in --risks/--recommendations silently splits the item and can fail CLI_ARGUMENT_MALFORMED — use 、 (AOS chain records this exact double rejection).

conference-append-position: --actor-id is the position author (persona profile), --actor is the attestation identity; omitting --actor makes the author stand in as attestation actor (cli/src/index.ts:1878-1899). Under the persona signing convention pass BOTH: --actor-id profile:tcrn-<role>-v1 and --actor agent:opus5.
--attest-dir must resolve OUTSIDE the workspace root (use the partition attestations/ sibling, never a path under workspace/), else CLI_ARGUMENT_MALFORMED before anything else runs.

Missing --actor after attestation enable fails the whole mutation closed (WORKSPACE_ACTOR_REQUIRED); missing --attest-dir does NOT fail — the event commits without a time receipt, silently breaking the partition witness convention.
--position/--title/--desired-outcome have a 2048 utf8-byte budget (CONFERENCE_BUDGET_EXCEEDED, conference.ts:29,65) — Chinese text hits it at ~680 characters.
external keys are canonicalized to UPPERCASE and must match ^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]*(-[A-Z0-9]+)*$ — lowercase input works but derives the same id as its uppercase form.
Story strictly requires an Epic parent and Initiative/Release must be parentless (GRAPH_PARENT_KIND_INVALID); Incident alone is parent-optional — decisive for the cross filing kind choice.
Minutes key band is inconsistent on AOS: conference #4's minutes used TCRN-AOS-MINUTES-004 while the others use TCRN-AOS-MIN-<n>; stick to MIN- going forward (next: MIN-007).
'--expected-version head' resolves under the lease and avoids stale-version CAS rejections; a hardcoded integer races any concurrent writer.
